theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiRH_measure_density_of_tangentPlane
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), (∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ μ (Metric.closedBall x δ) < ∞) → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P 1 → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ μ (Metric.closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
